import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getWeeklyRebateClaimData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/weeklyRebateClaim/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  const send = (title: string, md: ReturnType<typeof Format.createMarkdown>) => {
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title, content: md }));
  };

  try {
    const result = await getWeeklyRebateClaimData(uid, String(bid ?? ''), e.MessageText, createBackendRequestContext(e));
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'NO_MATCH':
        md.addText('请指定要领取的天数，例如：周周返利领取 1');
        send('', md);

        return;
      case 'INVALID_DAY':
        md.addText('请输入有效的天数（1-7 或 8 领取满勤大奖）');
        send('', md);

        return;
      case 'FAILED':
        md.addText(result.error);
        send('', md);

        return;
      case 'SUCCESS':
        md.addText(`领取${result.label}奖励成功！`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`获得：${result.rewardText}`);
        send('周周返利', md);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('领取周周返利奖励失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('领取失败，请稍后再试。');
    send('', md);
  }
});
